negativeScope: Six synthetic gate-validation controls do not constitute target evidence. negativeHarness.source:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,sys
root=Path.cwd();work=root/'build/.ci-tmp/gui-editor';results=[]
for case in ['missing-binary','missing-record-profile','missing-editor-profile','missing-record-assertion','missing-editor-assertion','previous-gui','editor-deadline']:
 directory=work/('negative-'+case);directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 if case!='missing-binary':
  for name in ['compatibility_fixture64','compatibility_fixture32','libcecore.so']:
   path=directory/name
   if not path.exists():path.symlink_to(root/'build'/name)
  if case=='previous-gui':
   driver=work/'sanitizer-baseline/driver'
   lines=['#!/usr/bin/env python3','import os,sys',"os.environ['ASAN_OPTIONS']='detect_leaks=0:abort_on_error=1'","os.environ['UBSAN_OPTIONS']='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1'",'mode="--records" if sys.argv[1]=="--injection-lifecycle-only" else "--editors"',f'os.execv({str(driver)!r},[{str(driver)!r},mode,sys.argv[2],sys.argv[3]])']
  else:
   lines=['#!/usr/bin/env python3','import sys,time','editor=sys.argv[1]=="--editor-injection-only"','prefix="GUI_EDITOR_INJECTION" if editor else "GUI_INJECTION"','count=77 if editor else 78',f'case={case!r}',"if editor and case=='editor-deadline':",' print("GUI_EDITOR_PARTIAL_BEFORE_TIMEOUT",flush=True)',' time.sleep(55)',"widths=[8] if (editor and case=='missing-editor-profile') or (not editor and case=='missing-record-profile') else [8,4]",'for width in widths:'," incomplete=width==4 and ((editor and case=='missing-editor-assertion') or (not editor and case=='missing-record-assertion'))",' for index in range(count-int(incomplete)): print(f"{prefix} {width} OK: synthetic gate-control assertion")',' print(f"{prefix}_RESULT width={width} checks={count} failures=0")']
  executable=directory/'gui_lifecycle_smoke';executable.write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n');executable.chmod(0o700)
 report=directory/'report.json'
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'test/gui_injection_gate.py',str(directory),'--report',str(report)],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=60)
 evidence=json.loads(report.read_text());results.append({'case':case,'exitCode':result.returncode,'report':evidence})
 assert result.returncode!=0 and not evidence['passed']
 if case.startswith('missing-editor') or case in ['previous-gui','editor-deadline']:assert evidence['runs'][0]['checks']==156
 if case=='previous-gui':assert 'ERROR: AddressSanitizer: heap-use-after-free' in evidence['output']
 if case=='editor-deadline':assert evidence.get('timedOut') and 'GUI_EDITOR_PARTIAL_BEFORE_TIMEOUT' in evidence['output'] and evidence['runs'][-1]['timedOut']
 print('gate control rejected:',case,flush=True)
 (work/'negative-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2))
